title: 射击游戏封装
problem_statement_md:
我们正在开发一个游戏。我们的玩家**Player**类有`name`属性和私有的`_lives`属性(生命值)。

`hit()`方法(射击)将减少玩家1个点的生命值。如果生命值等于`0`，则输出"Game Over"。
请完成`hit()`方法，使程序按预期工作。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Data Hiding[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

We are working on a game. Our [b]Player[/b] class has [b]name[/b] and private [b]_lives[/b] attributes.
The [b]hit[/b]() method should decrease the lives of the player by 1. In case the lives equal to 0, it should output "[b]Game Over[/b]".
Complete the hit() method to make the program work as expected.
[note]The code creates a [b]Player[/b] object and calls its [b]hit([/b]) method multiple times.[/note]
